verdict.rationale: Consensus has no native scheduled or background automation feature in the evidence. Users can only build their own automations by calling the REST API or MCP server, which the docs describe as running "automated searches" in custom workflows. The research agent chains tools such as citation crawling and DOI lookup, but nothing shows it running unattended in the background. Missing for 10: native scheduled/recurring automations, background or unattended agent runs, triggers/alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
